snippet.title: SLACKJAW | Announcement Trailer (NEW Unreal Engine 5 Horror Game)
snippet.description:
Wishlist "SLACKJAW" now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073900/SLACKJAW/
Stream "I've Been Watching You" (Trailer Version) on all platforms here: https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/taylorambrosiowood/ive-been-watching-you-feat-allegra-trailer-version
Vocal performance by Allegra
Music and Lyrics by: Taylor Ambrosio Wood
There will be a full version of the song in the game and on the soundtrack, so stay tuned!
More Songs with Allegra playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4NgYXF4KVDosRBYd065hIO?si=0838f5cae3dc466d

Socials:
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/r47gmJ3z6R
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@nostromointeractive
Website: https://www.taylorambrosiowood.com/nostromo
Support: https://ko-fi.com/nostromo

About SLACKJAW: As the latest prey of a deranged serial killer, you must use your wits and resources to survive this terrifying first-person horror game. Explore, uncover secrets, and plan your escape... but be quiet, or you'll be his next victim. Inspired by true events.

If you are a streamer and would like to request a Steam key, please contact me through my email or my website contact form. Thank you!

___
Lyrics:
"I've been watching you for some time,
I recognize that lonely look in your eyes,
and although we haven't event met yet,
I know that you feel it too,
I know that our love is true." ... more to come in the full version!

tags:  #SlackJaw #gaming #horrorgaming #newhorrorstories2024  #unrealengine5 #indiegamedev #residentevil #indiegamedevs #creepy #serialkillerdocumentary #indiehorror
